record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, truncate observed histories to the latest 32 items instead of 128 for both training and inference, retaining left padding and final-real-position readout. Most histories fit within 32 items; removing older context from longer histories may reduce stale-interest interference without the state averaging that regressed previously. Keep embeddings, GRU topology, scoring, loss, optimizer and training schedule fixed, and save maxlen=32 in predictor metadata.
